speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a newborn with a generalized rash; to help me understand this condition, has your baby been feeding well, and is there any associated fever or lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: The mother's history of treated gonorrhea raises concern for neonatal gonococcal infection. Can you describe the specific appearance of the rash, and have you noticed any discharge from the eyes or any discharge from the baby's urethra or vagina?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Sepsis (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection)
